mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmContactMngList*/ SELECT 1 AS MASTER_FLG, COM_CODE AS RECV_COM_CODE, SEQ AS RECV_SEQ, USER_NAME AS RECV_NAME, EMAIL AS RECV_MAIL, MOBILE AS RECV_MOBILE_NUMBER, REMARK AS RECV_REMARK, RECV_YN AS RECV_OPTION, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER, ADD_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS ADD_DATE FROM DM_CONTRACT_INFO WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND STATUS <> 'D' UNION SELECT 0 AS MASTER_FLG, u.COM_CODE AS RECV_COM_CODE, (SELECT NVL(max(TO_NUMBER(SEQ)),0)+1 FROM DM_CONTRACT_HIST WHERE COM_CODE=u.COM_CODE) AS RECV_SEQ, u.USER_NAME_LOC AS RECV_NAME, u.EMAIL AS RECV_MAIL, u.MOBILE_PHONE AS RECV_MOBILE_NUMBER, '관리자' AS RECV_REMARK, 'Y' AS RECV_OPTION, '' AS ADD_USER, '' AS ADD_USER_ID, '' AS ADD_DATE FROM icomcmpy c, ICOMLUSR u WHERE c.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND c.COM_CODE = u.COM_CODE AND u.USER_TYPE = 'A' ORDER BY MASTER_FLG ASC, RECV_SEQ DESC -- 0 대표연락처 부터 1 일반연락처 순으로 정렬;
